mechanism: Label each bar bullish(1) if Close>Open else bearish(0); count class frequencies over a fixed history (e.g. 1000 D1 bars) per symbol; majority share (e.g. USDJPY ~59% bull) is treated as directional market bias that ML classifiers overfit unless resampled.
data_needed: OHLC history; binary Close>Open labels; per-symbol unique counts and majority/minority ratios; optional F1/precision-recall instead of accuracy.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD, USTEC, XAUUSD, USDJPY, BTCUSD, CA60, UK100; PERIOD_D1; USDJPY RF/ONNX EA tests 2023-01-01 to 2025-01-01.
why_new_for_mis: Turns simple bar-direction class counts into an explicit cross-instrument regime-bias sensor—MIS can track when an instrument’s bull/bear prevalence flips rather than only modeling price level.
quote: none of the trading symbols are perfectly balanced as there are different numbers of bears and bulls candles that appeared historically.

mechanism: CTALib single-bar detectors: Doji via |open−close|<tolerance·_Point; Dragonfly/Gravestone via doji + shadow_ratio≥2; Hammer/InvertedHammer via min_body_percentage and shadow ratios; SpinningTop via small body + symmetric long shadows; Marubozu via open/close within tolerance of low/high. Emit 10 binary features to CatBoost for next-bar direction.
data_needed: Per-bar OHLC; point size; tunable tolerances (body_torrelance, shadow_ratio, body_percentage_threshold); CSV of pattern flags + OHLC.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: XAUUSD PERIOD_D1; collect 2005-01-01 to 2023-01-01; EA lookahead=1.
why_new_for_mis: Rule-parameterized single-bar candlestick geometry as a sparse indecision/momentum feature vector—MIS can sense Doji/SpinningTop-style indecision and Marubozu momentum without multi-bar pattern engines.
quote: The spinning top candlestick pattern was the most impactful feature to this model followed with the Doji candlestick

mechanism: Build a patterns vector of rare CDLs only (Doji, Dragonfly, Gravestone, Hammer, InvertedHammer, SpinningTop, Bullish/Bearish Marubozu); open a trade from the CatBoost signal only if patterns.Sum()>0, ignoring White/Black candle-only bars.
data_needed: Same OHLC CDL flags; online sum of special-pattern bits; model class prediction.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: XAUUSD PERIOD_D1; tester after gating showed ~54.55% profitable trades matching ~53% classification accuracy.
why_new_for_mis: Sparsity gate that treats rare candlestick geometry as an event sensor—MIS fires only when a non-trivial bar shape is present, not on every bar’s color.
quote: We only want to open a trade when there is some unique candlestick pattern detected other than the white and black candlestick.

mechanism: Clean MT5 chart screenshots (no grid/volumes); run foduucom stockmarket-pattern-detection YOLOv8; emit class labels (Head&Shoulders top/bottom, M-head/double top, W-bottom, triangles, stock line) plus box confidence; optional BMP overlay back onto chart via timer.
data_needed: ChartScreenShot PNG streams (e.g. 640×480, BarsToCapture/BarsShift); ultralytics YOLO model.pt; class id→name and conf per box.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD PERIOD_H1 screenshots; scheduled every 1 minute in deploy path.
why_new_for_mis: Vision-based geometric chart-pattern sensor with confidence scores—MIS can detect classical reversal/continuation shapes from image space when tabular rules fail.

mechanism: Run Augmented Dickey–Fuller on close series; if p>0.05 treat as non-stationary; compare ACF after 1st vs 2nd differencing and pick minimal d that yields near-zero ACF lag and ADF p≈0; feed (p,d,q) via PACF/ACF or auto_arima into ARIMA/SARIMA close forecasts with iterative append updates.
data_needed: Close series (e.g. 1000+ D1 bars); adfuller p-values; ACF/PACF plots; auto_arima AIC search.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD; mt5.TIMEFRAME_D1; ~1000–4007+ bars; seasonal m=5 weekly cycle trial.
why_new_for_mis: Stationarity order d as an online regime attribute of the price process—MIS can flag when a series requires differencing (trending/integrated) vs already mean-reverting.
quote: the p-value is way greater than the significance level (0.05). Let us differentiate the series once, then twice

mechanism: Fit SARIMAX(p,d,q)×(P,D,Q,S) with S=m=5 on daily closes to capture weekly recurrence; auto_arima seasonal=True searches seasonal orders; forecast with append(refit=False); residual diagnostics (hetero, ACF of residuals) judge unexplained structure.
data_needed: Daily close series; seasonal period m; auto_arima seasonal search; SARIMAX fit and one-step forecasts.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD D1; m=5 trading-day week; real-time schedule.every(1).days close forecast.
why_new_for_mis: Explicit seasonal-component sensor for FX weekly session structure—MIS can separate seasonal recurrence from non-seasonal ARIMA dynamics.
quote: in forex instruments we can spot increased market volatility during certain trading sessions etc.

mechanism: Difference OHLC to stationarity; fit VAR(p) with p chosen by AIC (up to 29 lags); each of Diff_Open/High/Low/Close is regressed on lags of all four; residual correlation matrix shows shared shocks (e.g. Diff_High–Diff_Close ~0.77).
data_needed: EURUSD OHLC (~10000 D1 bars); np.diff; VAR.select_order(maxlags=30); residual corr matrix.
why_new_for_mis: Joint multivariate bar-component sensor—MIS reads how open/high/low/close innovations co-move rather than forecasting close alone.
quote: A high correlation between diff_high/diff_close (0.77) and diff_low/diff_close (approximately: 0.766) suggests common unexplained factors affect these pairs.

mechanism: Retrain VAR on features high_open=high−open and open_low=open−low; one-step forecast yields expected upward and downward candle excursions; use as TP/SL distances with SMA(20) direction filter (close>SMA → buy with TP=+high_open, SL=−open_low).
data_needed: Recent OHLC window ≥ k_ar+1; differenced high_open/open_low; VAR forecast steps=1; SMA20 on closes.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD D1; schedule every 1 minute; SMA window=20.
why_new_for_mis: Predictive intra-bar range legs as a volatility/excursion sensor for stops—MIS senses expected up-move vs down-move magnitude from the open, not just scalar ATR.
quote: The predicted values high_open and open_low are used for setting the take profit and stop loss of a trade respectively for a buy trade and vice versa for a sell trade.

mechanism: N-BEATS stacks of MLP blocks emit forecast+backcast; residuals cascade stack-to-stack; basis-expansion layers decompose into trend/seasonality-like components; NeuralForecast NBEATS(h=30, input_size=90, robust scaler) on univariate close (unique_id, ds, y).
data_needed: Daily closes with unique_id/ds/y; lookback input_size; horizon h; max_steps; optional predict(df=new) without full retrain.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: NAS100 TIMEFRAME_D1; 1000 bars; horizon 30 days; split_date 2024-01-01.
why_new_for_mis: Interpretable neural basis expansion that attributes forecast moves to trend vs seasonal stacks—MIS sequence sensor beyond black-box LSTM point forecasts.
quote: The N-BEATS model allows clear attributions, e.g., "This spike in the data is because of the trend" or "this drop is seasonal", this is achieved via basis expansion layers

mechanism: Concatenate related series (NAS100 and US500) with distinct unique_id; one NeuralForecast NBEATS trains globally so patterns learned on one index transfer to the other; per-id MAPE/R² evaluation; trading bot compares today’s predicted close vs ask for TP direction.
data_needed: Paired daily closes for ≥2 symbols; unique_id column; shared horizon/input_size; per-id metrics.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: NAS100 and US500; TIMEFRAME_D1; 1000 bars each; schedule daily 00:00.
why_new_for_mis: Panel neural forecast as a cross-asset sequence sensor—MIS can borrow structure across related equity indices instead of isolated univariate models.
quote: This is an impressive ability of this model because it leverages patterns learned on one series and uses them to improve the overall forecast for both time series.

mechanism: DeepAR LSTM autoregressive model trained on fractional close returns with MultivariateNormalDistributionLoss; predict mode=raw yields distributional forecasts (intervals/quantiles); convert last-step predicted return × last close into price_delta for SL/TP and sign as direction.
data_needed: OHLC→returns; time_idx; group_ids; max_encoder_length (e.g. 24); max_prediction_length (e.g. 6); hour/day_of_week/month categoricals; GroupNormalizer log1p.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD TIMEFRAME_H1 (1000 bars) then D1 multicurrency; prediction_length=6.
why_new_for_mis: Full predictive distribution over returns as an uncertainty/volatility sensor—MIS can act on quantile width and P50 sign, not a single point forecast.
quote: Deep AR doesn't just produce a single point "point estimate" for future values; it learns the outputs and a full distribution over future points.

mechanism: Train one DeepAR jointly on many FX returns series (EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY, USDCHF, AUDUSD, USDCAD, NZDUSD) with shared RNN; time-varying known categoricals hour/day_of_week/month; inference yields (group_ids × horizon) predictions consumed per symbol for directional trades.
data_needed: Per-symbol rates concatenated with symbol group_id; returns target; calendar categoricals; synchronized dataloaders; multi CTrade/CSymbolInfo.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Seven major FX pairs; TIMEFRAME_D1 multicurrency bot; H1 single-symbol prototype.
why_new_for_mis: Global multi-FX sequence model with calendar covariates—MIS senses shared cross-pair return dynamics and session/season effects in one network.
quote: When your dataset contains hundreds of related time series, DeepAR outperforms the standard ARIMA and ETS methods.
